name: tab-archaeologist
description: Local, non-destructive tab grouping suggestions for Firefox and Chromium.

scripts.build: vite build --mode chromium && vite build --mode firefox && node scripts/finalize.mjs both
scripts.build:chromium: vite build --mode chromium && node scripts/finalize.mjs chromium
scripts.build:firefox: vite build --mode firefox && node scripts/finalize.mjs firefox
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run lint:firefox
